Loadout Sharing

Ludd spoke: "The holy path, once found, is not the finder’s prize, but the fleet’s inheritance. All things are common among the faithful, that the fleet outlast the night."

Utility mod that lets you copy and paste ship variants as json data.

descriptionHtml:
Loadout Sharing

Ludd spoke: "The holy path, once found, is not the finder’s prize, but the fleet’s inheritance. All things are common among the faithful, that the fleet outlast the night."


     


Utility mod that lets you copy and paste ship variants as json data.

Requirements
  • WrapUI (download)

Compatibility
  • Can be added mid-save
  • Can be removed mid-save
  • Releases are always compatible with previous ones

Credits
  • rolfosian - for providing the reflection library
  • SCC - for providing the idea for the mod
aiDescription: Adds a utility feature that allows players to copy ship variants in JSON format and paste them elsewhere. This enables easy sharing of loadouts between players or across different games. The mod is designed to be safe to add or remove during an ongoing save.
